dedupe_keys.name: elexonpy gb balancing data api client

description: elexonpy is a generated Python client for ELEXON's electricity data API. The README documents pip installation and examples that retrieve demand data and turn responses into dataframes. Users call the relevant endpoint for demand, generation or balancing records; outputs are structured observations for their analysis. Geographic coverage is Great Britain's electricity market as represented in the ELEXON service. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing and the repository is under Open Climate Fix's archives organisation. A limitation is that generated code can become stale when an API changes; provider data definitions, revisions and service limits must be checked separately. This client can prepare demand and balancing series for grid dispatch or resilience simulations. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model is a separate optimiser. No ELEXON records, key or package were downloaded.
